newsitem.title: UK: UK's BTR unit buys U.S. firm ECM Motor.
newsitem.headline: UK's BTR unit buys U.S. firm ECM Motor.

text.p: British diversified conglomerate BTR Plc said on Tuesday one of its units, BTR Power Drives, had agreed to acquire ECM Motor Company Inc for an undisclosed sum.
The completion of the transaction would take place on May 29, 1997, the company said.
Based in Elkhorn, Wisconsin, ECM is a leading manufacturer of sub-fractional and fractional horsepower gear motors and related electric motors used in several industries.
In 1996 ECM had sales of 28 million stg and net assets involved in the transaction was about 13 million stg.
"The acquisition of ECM broadens the BTR Power Drives group and enables it to provide the widest spectrum of gearmotors within the industry," BTR executive director Paul Buysse said.
